description:
Get all links (issue links and web links) associated with a test case in Zephyr

**Toolset:** Test Cases

**Parameters:**
- testCaseKey (string) *required*: The key of the test case. Test case keys are of the format [A-Z]+-T[0-9]+

**Examples:**
1. Get all links associated with the test case with key 'SA-T10'
```json
{
  "testCaseKey": "SA-T10"
}
```
Expected Output: The links (issue links and web links) associated with the test case

testCaseKey.description: The key of the test case. Test case keys are of the format [A-Z]+-T[0-9]+

name: zephyr_get_test_case_links

outputSchema.description: A list of links for this test case.

issues.description: A list of Jira issues linked to this entity

id.description: The ID that represents the link between the entity and the Jira issue.

self.description: The Zephyr REST API endpoint relative to the link between the entity and the Jira issue.

target.description: The Jira Cloud REST API endpoint to get the full representation of the issue

self.description: The REST API endpoint to get more resource details.

webLinks.description: A list of web links for this entity

self.description: The Zephyr REST API endpoint relative to the link between the entity and this web link.

title: Zephyr: Get Test Case Links
